mapper.select: select fundId, finprodName, serialNo, interType, xmlStatus from (SELECT BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID fundId, BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_NAME finprodName, SIV.SERIALNO serialNo, '2' interType, DECODE(SIV.XML_STATUS, null, 0, SIV.XML_STATUS) xmlStatus FROM BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO BASI LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET BB ON BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID = BASI.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN SZT_INTERF_VALUATION SIV ON SIV.FINPROD_ID = BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AND SIV.INTER_TYPE = '2' WHERE BB.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE = 'F16') where 1=1 and fundId = #{fundId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and xmlStatus = #{xmlStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
